name: Exage LX 7-speed 12–28T cassette
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 325 g for the seven-speed CS-HG50 E 12/14/16/18/21/24/28T cassette including spacers. The existing I 13–23T and M 13–28T references are not assigned this mass; lockring inclusion follows the contribution convention.
